RagShortTexts: The Varangian Guard protected Byzantine emperors in Nicaean exile, wielding two-handed.

Variants.Content: The Varangian Guard remained the legendary royal bodyguard of the Byzantine emperors during their exile in Nicaea. Composed of Norse warriors and Anglo-Saxon refugees who fled Norman England, these armored axemen carried six-foot Danish battleaxes, swearing lifelong oaths to defend the purple-born basileus.
Untangled from court conspiracies, Varangians guarded treasury chambers and throne rooms under strict military honor, serving Michael VIII Palaiologos during the campaign to reclaim Constantinople.
Towering northern giants who drink mead by the flagon, they stand impassive on guard duty. When their heavy Danish axes cleave downward, they split iron bascinets down to the teeth.
